messages:
Ana (Sales): Hey team — Acme POC stuck: they can't finish SSO/SCIM onboarding. They say groups aren't syncing and Dedicated pool role binding isn't applied. cc @Kai
Jamie (SE): Can you paste the SCIM error from their tenant? 403 is usually token scope related.
Ana (Sales): They forwarded this provisioning log snippet: 
`POST /scim/v2/Groups -> 403 Forbidden: scope "user.write" required`
Ana (Sales): Also their SAML assertion is coming with NameID format `transient` which we don't accept by default.
Kai (Onboarding): We expect NameID = email (persistent/emailAddress). Ask them to set NameID format to `urn:oasis:names:tc:SAML:1.1:nameid-format:emailAddress`.
Kai (Onboarding): SCIM token in our dashboard shows missing scopes — needs `Users:Write` and `Groups:ReadWrite`. I'll mark the tenant as blocked until token is reissued.
Morgan (Security): Quick note: if they enable Groups:Write we only ingest group membership for entitlements after they sign the attr-release portion of the security questionnaire. Please get confirmation.
Ana (Sales): Customer says they can't change NameID — their IdP is locked to transient by policy. They asked if we can accept groups via SAML attribute instead of SCIM.
Jamie (SE): We can accept a `groups` attribute in the assertion (`<Attribute Name=\"groups\">`), limited to ~100 group values. For full org sync (and automated role mapping) SCIM is preferred.
Jamie (SE): Workaround: we can provision them into the Dedicated pool manually (temporary role mapping) while IdP team fixes SCIM/NameID.
Provision Bot: SCIM provisioning attempt recorded:
```
POST /scim/v2/Groups 401 -> 403
{
  "detail": "Insufficient scope: groups.write required"
}
```
Kai (Onboarding): Ops approved a 1-week Dedicated trial for POC tenant if SCIM is fixed. I need: new SCIM token (with correct scopes), updated SAML metadata (NameID change or groups attribute), and confirmation of attr-release for groups.
Ana (Sales): Also flagged by customer: pricing worry for Dedicated during POC — they'd prefer using hosted API keys for functional tests. Any blockers? :thinking_face:
Jamie (SE): Hosted keys are fine for functional tests but won't mirror Dedicated latency/throughput. Offer hosted for early validation and the one-week Dedicated trial for performance tests.
Morgan (Security): Once SCIM token is submitted we'll run a quick scope/audit. Ask them to rotate the token post-POC.
Ana (Sales): I'll ask Acme to: 1) reissue SCIM token with `users.write, groups.write` 2) change NameID to email or add `groups` attribute to SAML 3) sign attr-release for groups. I'll loop back here when they reply. /remind me in 2 days to follow up. :thumbsup:
